evidence.quote: We judged that the case for an increase has strengthened but decided for the time being to wait for further evidence of continued progress toward our objectives.
most participants do expect that one increase in the federal funds rate will be appropriate this year.
Compared with the projections made in June, the median path for the federal funds rate has been revised down ¼ to ½ percentage point.
the economy has a little more room to run than might have been previously thought.
But we are seeing signs suggesting possible slippage there, and we're a long way from being—facing the problems that Japan faces.
Moreover, the Committee judges the risks to the outlook to be roughly balanced.

parsed.rationale: The Fed held rates but said the case for a hike strengthened and most expect one increase this year, a hawkish lean. This is offset by a lower projected rate path, below-target inflation, more labor-market running room and continued reinvestment, leaving a near-neutral, slightly hawkish net signal.
